summary: Iter-83 Order Status Policy + Pending bucket — full end-to-end verification on PREVIEW with amasi.jewelery@gmail.com. Backend 7/7 NEW pytests PASS. Backend numbers confirm spec exactly: totals net=415,314.24, pending_gross=159,276.66 across 768 pending orders, refunded=37 (39 incl other), cancelled=59. Per-gateway live recompute verified via curl: PUT /api/order-status-policy moving 'تم المراجعة' → confirmed raised net to 482,423.61 (+67,109.37) and dropped pending_gross to 89,531.78 (-69,744.88); POST /reset restored baseline exactly. Invalid category correctly returns 400 with Arabic error message. Dashboard /dashboard renders dashboard-pending-orders-empty correctly (filter is 'اليوم' = 2026-06-06 = 0 orders, same iter-43 carry-over). Accounts /accounts shows accounts-pending-orders card above the gateways table with 159,276.66 / 768 طلب and per-gateway breakdown (مدى 324/64,185.02 26.9%, البطاقة الائتمانية 107/25,867.35 24.1%, تمارا 119/25,110.94 25.9%, etc.) — matches backend exactly. UnifiedPaymentGatewaysCard on Accounts has the new 'معلَّق' column populated AND the 'معلَّق إضافي 159,276.66 (768 طلب)' hint near net total = 415,314.24. Cross-page consistency confirmed: Settings legend = Accounts pending card = Unified Gateways pending column = backend totals.pending_gross all = 159,276.66.
